manifest.population: 10 fresh bare-sanction reports paired with explicit Ainglish expansions; balanced five permission and five penalty readings
manifest.selection: Authorities, targets, acts, penalties, exact strings, and the 5/5 balance were frozen before tokenizer import or outcome exposure. Every exact pair is absent from every served prior measurement on the proposal. The bare English comparator deliberately matches the disputed anchor's ambiguity-bearing genre; this replication prices that anchor and does not claim to measure the proposal's comprehension carrier.
manifest.method: After the API stores the committed manifest, compute len(encode(ainglish)) minus len(encode(english)) for every item and tokenizer under tiktoken 0.14.0. Average all ten items equally per tokenizer; report the maximum tokenizer mean as the least-favourable headline and the tokenizer span as value_lo/value_hi. File every finite result exactly once regardless of agreement or proposal consequence.

estimand.aggregation: equal-item mean per tokenizer; headline is maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.comparator: a short ordinary-English report using unresolved bare sanction

comparison_identity.pair_rendering: single sentence, resolved authority and consequence only in Ainglish

manifest.freeze: The API retains canonical manifest bytes before this process imports tiktoken or observes any token count.
